## Design

### 2026-11-03: I have spent a long while on my project today because I am very excited. The free-reign has allowed me to create a dice roller for when I play dungeons and dragons. I want to have d4, d6, d8, d10, d12

**6h**

I have spent a long while on my project today because I am very excited. The free-reign has allowed me to create a dice roller for when I play dungeons and dragons. I want to have d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, and d20 functionality but pins on a Pro Micro limit to 20 LEDs and 4 buttons to change to what I want, or I can scrap the d20 (the most useful one). I doubt my budget will allow for more than a Pro Micro though, because it isn't really complicated enough to justify putting in enough work for a higher tier. The schematic and PCB editing are done, and I made a start on the github, which I will continue tomorrow I guess...

### 2026-11-05: Big day today. Began the coding and started assigning pins... Then realized that pins 11-13 on Pro Micro can't be used for LEDs apparently. So redid my entire schematic (and added more resistors), the

**7.5h**

Big day today. Began the coding and started assigning pins... Then realized that pins 11-13 on Pro Micro can't be used for LEDs apparently. So redid my entire schematic (and added more resistors), then the PCB editor, then Gerbers and KiCad files which I have uploaded to the GitHub as well. My code is probably 2/3 finished, but numbers need tweaking and I haven't created the proper display, just a draft system.
